claim:tstmd-contraction-reorientation.proposition: Cell–ECM mechanical coupling (real TST-MD, 2D) — NOT reproduced
claim:tstmd-contraction-reorientation.hypothesis: A contractile cell coupled to the fiber network via adhesions will pull those adhesions (and the crosslinked fibers they grip) toward its centre as it contracts, so the adhesion-ring radius and near-fiber density track the cell — reproducing Keijzer & Merks 2026 Fig 4.

primary_tests.name: Cell drags its adhesions (and the ECM) inward as it contracts
primary_tests.pass_if: adhesion-ring radius decreases by >= 30% as the cell contracts

primary_tests.name: Fibers reorient strongly toward the cell (matrix remodeling)

evidence_refs: real coupled TST-MD run (single contractile cell, 300 MCS)
Cell drags its adhesions (and the ECM) inward as it contracts
Fibers reorient strongly toward the cell (matrix remodeling)

claim:tstmd-network-connectivity.proposition: ECM network percolation vs crosslinking (real TST-MD, 2D) — NOT reproduced
claim:tstmd-network-connectivity.hypothesis: Increasing the number of crosslinks drives the fiber network through a percolation transition, so the giant-component fraction approaches ~1.0 at high crosslink density (as in the paper).

primary_tests.name: Fiber network percolates at high crosslinking
primary_tests.pass_if: giant_component reaches >= 0.8 at the highest crosslink setting

evidence_refs: real crosslink sweep (6 settings) through TST-MD
Fiber network percolates at high crosslinking

narrative.question:
Can we reproduce the cell-ECM mechanical-reciprocity phenomena of Keijzer &
Merks 2026 (arXiv:2609.02375, a 3D hybrid cellular Potts model coupled to a
discrete deformable fiber network — code unreleased) by driving the REAL
published 2D ancestor engine (Tsingos et al. 2023 static-adhesion TST-MD)
on ordinary hardware?

decisions.title: Refactor CellularPotts::DeltaH to floating point (stop int-rounding adh_dh) and rebuild the image?
decisions.detail: ca.cpp:575 rounds the ECM work to int, erasing sub-unit resistance. Engine instrumentation confirmed adhesions DO move (sync works); the blocker is bistability. See study followup_proposals FP-01 and docs/cell-ecm-coupling.md.

decisions.title: Implement physical->internal unit-scaling (Frontiers Table 1, K=Y*A/L) so adh_dh grows with fiber stretch and escapes bistability?
decisions.detail: The drag->densify->stiffen feedback never ignites because resistance is ~constant. This is the principled fix that should also recover Fig 2/3 magnitudes. See FP-02.

decisions.title: Obtain the Merks lab's exact figure configuration (Zenodo 7906973 / contact) to confirm the public demo build isn't missing a mechanism?
decisions.detail: The paper's contraction-experiment parameters are not in the public code/docs. See FP-03.

decisions.title: Run the percolation study at near-paper-scale density on GPU/HOOMD?
decisions.detail: Giant component saturates ~0.30 at CPU-tractable sizes. See tstmd-network-connectivity FP-01/FP-02.
